allTitle: Safety data sheets of this site
nothingKept: This tablet keeps no safety data sheets yet
nothingKeptText: It takes them the next time it is online with someone signed in. Until then, the sheet on the cabinet's wall has the pictograms and the PPE.

noCabinetText: The label may be old, or of another site: ask the safety officer. Every cabinet of this site is in the list above.

emptyText: The office adds them in Plant › Chemicals & waste.
noSheet: No safety data sheet yet: ask the safety officer before using it.
notKeptText: This sheet came after the tablet last went online: it takes it at the next connection.
refreshing: Kept on {at}: bringing it up to date…

offline: No network: the sheets kept on {at}.
